name: Ethan's New Client
source:
One and a half years after the release of Edition 1, we now finally continue the story of Ethan. The personal trainer that has no problem showing off his own body (to motivate you of course) and then when your blood starts boiling, yells at you to work harder on the equipment.

In this premium edition, you’ll have to go through Ethan’s exhausting workout sessions before he’ll let you head for the showers or enjoy some relaxing time in the sauna. Think you’re up for it?
translation:
第一版发布一年半后，我们终于继续讲述伊森的故事。私人教练会毫不犹豫地炫耀自己的身体（当然是为了激励你），然后当你的血液开始沸腾时，他会对你大喊大叫，让你在器材上更加努力。

在这个高级版本中，你必须经历伊森令人筋疲力尽的锻炼课程，然后他才会让你去淋浴或在桑拿浴室享受一些放松的时间。你认为你能胜任吗？
